page.layout: One running table of names in a single ruled column, with the years on its left and marginal notes on its right. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword "Ioannes" at lower right beneath the column.

main_text.l: 1350 | Otto Poder.Transactio civitatis Groning. cum Reinoldi Coverdie, & Drentinis.

page.notes: The year figures are beside the column and belong to it. "352" has a raised final figure, read as 352 [?]. "1354" is printed as "1.54" with a stray dot, read as 1354 [?]. The entry for 1351 is blank in print. The mark "•" after 1350 is a stray printed dot, not a reference mark. "(ging." after Renger and "(borch." after Cater are printed as they stand, apparently overflow fragments of the wrapped words "Hu-ging" and "Ham-borch". The table has no full stop after the final "Ioannes" line because it is the catchword. The Google watermark at lower right is not transcribed.
